existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: DeviceRequest has material local R4-to-R6 breaks: mandatory `code[x]` is now `product[x]`, several optional elements were removed/merged into CodeableReference forms, and R6 adds modifier/terminology semantics that older systems cannot safely ignore. The largest uncertainty is official cross-version mapping guidance for removed fields and new request-status/intent codes.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration should be transform-driven, not parser-tolerant. Rename mandatory product fields, wrap Reference values in CodeableReference where required, merge/split reason and performer role information carefully, preserve removed protocol links with an agreed extension if needed, and define policy for R6-only negative requests, quantity/location/PRN details, requester targets, and request status/intent codes.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for local structural deltas because both assigned StructureDefinitions and package indexes were available and directly compared. Confidence is medium for the precise business mapping of some changes because official diffs, narrative migration notes, and cross-version ConceptMaps were not supplied. Example-bound terminology comparisons are lower risk because their binding strength is not required.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
DeviceRequest keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 6 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 0 potential hard break(s), 6 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 2 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 1, which creates weak stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 95/100, producing migration shape `major-model-remodel`, major migration `Yes`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

7 finding(s) identify a yes/partial less-breaking base-design alternative, so the aggregate should not be used to dismiss local avoidability review.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: Mandatory code[x] was replaced by mandatory product[x] and gained canonical(DeviceDefinition)
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: unconverted R4 `codeCodeableConcept` or `codeReference` properties do not satisfy the required R6 `product[x]` element; R6 `productCanonical` also has no native R4 equivalent.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Protocol-definition links instantiatesCanonical and instantiatesUri were removed from DeviceRequest
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 instances containing either removed property are not valid against the R6 DeviceRequest shape, and preserving the data requires an extension or external policy.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: reasonCode and reasonReference were merged into reason CodeableReference
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 reason arrays are not R6 fields; reverse conversion of combined CodeableReference entries can be lossy because R4 lacks a per-reason pairing container.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: priorRequest was removed and a narrower replaces element was added
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: the old property name is rejected in R6, and even after renaming, non-DeviceRequest targets no longer fit the R6 target profile.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: performer changed at the same path from Reference to CodeableReference
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: runtime/API/codegen: the same path now has an incompatible datatype and JSON shape, so generated models, FHIRPath, serializers, and business logic that expected a direct Reference must change.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: old instances with `performerType` are rejected by the R6 base resource unless converted to `performer.concept` or preserved out of band.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
